posts.name: zastels
posts.cooked:
I noticed right away that the intro quests are all broken English, super short statement based sentences.

I literally cannot believe how low quality the developers are at Blizzard now. These quests are written by an idiot who struggles with English.

Why is the game so easy and so complicated? I can auto attack mobs to death and not die? The amount of new dumb currencies is crazy. Why can I not fly in Stormwind now?!

This is 0/10 absolute bottom tier quality when compared to Classic Wow.

Everyone needs to be fired at Blizzard, specially Metzen because that dude is now only a professional at walking on egg shells and nothing else.
